bibl.title: Demotic Letters from the Sacred Animal Necropolis of North Saqqara: The Final Instalment.
bibl.seg: Cary J. Martin, H.S. Smith & Sue Davies, Demotic Letters from the Sacred Animal Necropolis of North Saqqara: The Final Instalment.

Koenraad Donker van Heel, Francisca A.J. Hoogendijk & Cary J. Martin (edd.), Hieratic, Demotic and Greek Studies and Text Editions. Of Making Many Books There Is No End: Festschrift in Honour of Sven P. Vleeming = Papyrologica Lugduno-Batava. XXXIV (Leiden - Boston, 2018) pp. 123-147, figg.
